sentences.text: A genomic study set out to clarify the ambiguous taxonomy of A. naeslundii, whose strains were grouped as genospecies I and II and then classified as A. oris and A. naeslundii.

A study of supragingival plaque from 21 patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease and 20 healthy individuals reported A. naeslundii enriched in patients and correlated with clinical indices.
The same study reported that oral administration of A. naeslundii aggravated fatty liver phenotypes and induced gut dysbiosis in mice fed a high-fat diet.
